namespace: Orchestrate independent background subagents for concurrent execution.
instructions: Offload parallel, self-contained work to subagents while continuing your own work. A subagent can handle internally coupled steps, but subagents must remain independent of each other. Keep shared coupling in the current agent, or isolate potential conflicts in git worktrees for the main agent to merge. Use subagent_list to check child or parent status. Use write or msg_write to the agent address to send messages without opening custom socket connections. Messaging a stopped agent revives it and starts a new round. Use the parent address to reach your parent, or children.sock to broadcast to all direct children.

create.description: Create independent background agents. Waits until every child has dispatched its first model call through the SDK, then returns id and socket, without status. Does not wait for model output or task completion. Startup failure reports the failed IDs; registered agents remain and must not be blindly recreated.
create.snippet: Delegate independent tasks to background agents
create.guideline: Write requirements for subagents primarily in English.

parameters.context: Background, constraints, and source material shared by every task in this batch.

tasks.description: Independent tasks. Order is preserved in the result, but it does not create execution dependencies.

items.name: Caller-facing label; defaults to none.
items.task: Self-contained assignment: deliverable, scope, and how to verify completion.
items.inheritContext: Copy this session's conversation, system prompt, model, and thinking at creation time. Default false: start without this session's chat history.

list.description: Return a children tree: Main roots its view at Main; a child roots its view at its direct parent, with peers (including self) and its own children. Each group is capped at four: active first, then most recently stopped. Main expands visible active children; stopped nodes and peers are not expanded. all: true returns the full tree. id selects a visible subtree, or null if absent. When durable storage is enabled, the root carries historyDir containing per-Job <jobId>/summary.md and transcript.jsonl across all rounds; agents carry their latest history paths. Use read to inspect summary.md for outcomes or transcript.jsonl for full messages. Main has no per-Job history paths. Does not wait for completion.
list.snippet: Check background agent progress and history paths

parameters.all: Show every agent, including Main and stopped agents, without group limits. Default false.
parameters.id: Optional agent id selecting a visible subtree. Returns null if absent; use all: true to query outside the default view.

stop.description: Request cancellation of an agent by id. May return stopping or finalizing while execution or history writes finish; does not wait for shutdown.
stop.snippet: Cancel a background agent's current run

msg_write.description: Send a plain-text message to a managed Agent IPC endpoint: Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe. The host binds the sender and transport framing. Omit from/to, JSON or NDJSON envelopes, and trailing newlines. Cannot write files.
msg_write.snippet: Send plain-text messages to agents through their Socket paths
guidelines: Provide the message body as plain text content; do not add from/to, JSON/NDJSON framing, a trailing newline, or a custom Socket client.

parameters.path: Returned Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe address.
parameters.content: Plain-text message body. The host frames the transport and binds the sender.
